additionalProperties.description:
Key must be the name of a file (including extension) under `./image/`.

Filename schema can be found in `./filename-schema.md`.

artist.description:
The artist's social platform and username, separated by a slash (no spaces).

If artist cannot be specified, this should be null.

source.description:
The source article URL of the image.

If the source cannot be specified, the artist's social platform URL should be used instead. If the artist cannot be specified either, this should be null.

default.description: List of avatars to use under no special case.

halloween.description: List of avatars to use during October.
